claim_scores.rationale: Patches `litellm.responses` directly and captures the outbound kwargs there via `fake_responses(..., **request)`.
Constructs `dspy.LM(..., model_type="responses", ...)` and calls `lm.forward(..., response_format=AnswerModel)` with a Pydantic model.
Reads `call["text"]["format"]` and asserts `response_format` is absent from the sent payload, showing the rewrite into `text.format`.
Asserts JSON-schema conversion with `name == "AnswerModel"`, `type == "json_schema"`, and schema field checks on `properties`, which is an acceptable equivalent check.
